description: Search the NeedAnAI catalogue of 15,000+ AI tools by free text, pricing model, category or task. Returns ranked hits with pricing, status, freshness (when the site was last confirmed alive) and canonical URLs, plus facet counts and a separate, labelled sponsored block. Use list_taxonomy for valid ca

labels.name: get_tool
labels.description: Full profile of one tool by slug: description, pricing model and details (with when pricing was last checked), pricing history, pros, cons, FAQs, categories, tasks, media, site status, freshness and up to five alternatives. Ends with a provenance line.

labels.name: find_alternatives
labels.description: Alternatives to a tool, ranked by freshness, profile completeness, curation and how many other tools list them as an alternative. Each entry carries a rationale. Optionally restrict to the same pricing model.

labels.name: compare_tools
labels.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 tools: pricing, summary, categories, tasks, pros, cons, site status, freshness, flags and launch date.

labels.name: recommend_for_task
labels.description: Given a job to be done ("create a logo", "transcribe meetings") and an optional budget, returns the best-fitting tools with an explicit rationale per recommendation. Resolves known task slugs first, then falls back to free-text search.

labels.name: list_taxonomy
labels.description: All category or task slugs with names and live tool counts. Use the slugs as filters for search_tools and recommend_for_task.

labels.name: search_articles
labels.description: Search 660+ editorial articles (reviews, comparisons, alternatives round-ups, guides) by keywords and optional category.

labels.name: get_article
labels.description: The full markdown body of one article by slug.

labels.name: check_status
labels.description: Is the tool’s site alive? Returns the scanner verdict, when it was last checked and verified, when pricing was last checked, and a freshness label.

labels.name: watch_tool
labels.description: Subscribe to status and pricing changes for a tool (checked every 30 minutes). Delivered to an https webhook or email. Requires an API key (free, from https://needanai.com/profile?tab=api-keys).

labels.name: list_watches
labels.description: Active watches on this API key.

labels.name: submit_tool
labels.description: Suggest a tool for the catalogue. If its website is already listed the existing listing is returned instead. Requires an API key.

labels.name: export_tools
labels.description: Bulk export of a filtered slice of the catalogue (up to 2,000 rows) as JSON or CSV. Returns a signed download URL valid for 24 hours. Requires an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, search_articles · Private data: watch_tool, list_watches, submit_tool, export_tools · Public sink: watch_tool, submit_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, search_articles · Private data: watch_tool, list_watches, submit_tool, export_tools · Public sink: watch_tool, submit_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
